transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get the pre-offer huddle started. We've got the fifteen-minute guest segment at 7:40 PM on Saturday evening, and it needs to wrap before the 8:00 PM news break. Lio Hart and Mara Vale are our two finalists, with Mara Vale currently holding the larger public profile. I'll be making the final booking call, but I need to hear from each of you first -- artist relations, broadcast engineering, clearance, and sponsor integration. What are your latest findings on both candidates?

transcript.text: Important update from artist relations: I confirmed with both agents this afternoon that Mara Vale's hold was released and she cannot appear Saturday.
